recommendations.title: Adopt exit strategy: early_75pct_mfe
recommendations.description: Modify Normal ML exit logic to use the highest-ranked simulated exit. Strategy: early_75pct_mfe.
recommendations.evidence: Best exit achieves PF=7.840 vs actual PF=0.732; avg_pnl=229.5
recommendations.risk: Simulation uses MFE/MAE proxies; live path dynamics may differ

recommendations.title: Raise minimum confidence threshold to 0.46
recommendations.description: Only execute Normal ML trades when model confidence >= new threshold. Calibration analysis shows over-confidence at low probability buckets.
recommendations.evidence: Threshold 0.46 → expectancy=67.2 vs baseline=-41.5; PF=1.486; retains 7.1% trades (4,711)
recommendations.risk: Higher threshold = fewer signals; tail risk of under-trading

recommendations.title: Add regime-gating: skip or confirm before entering RANGE trades
recommendations.description: Range regime win rate (39.1%) lags non-range (39.9%). Identified 4 specific skip/delay conditions.
recommendations.evidence: Win rate gap = 0.8 pp; range trades = 17,238
recommendations.risk: Regime proxy is computed; may misclassify transitional sessions

recommendations.title: Address Cluster 0: low-confidence
recommendations.description: Cluster accounts for 26.3% of losing trades (₹2,926,557 loss). Dominant: regime=mixed, side=pe. Recommended: skip_entry.
recommendations.risk: Cluster labels are unsupervised — validate each cluster manually before applying rules

recommendations.title: Apply Entry Quality Score >= 30
recommendations.description: Reject trades with Entry Quality Score < 30/100. Score is computed from ADX, DI spread, SuperTrend, EMA alignment, VWAP, RSI zone, trend strength, momentum velocity, and market regime.
recommendations.evidence: Score >= 30 retains 85.9% of trades; PF=0.735 vs baseline 0.732; avg_pnl=-40.8
recommendations.risk: Heuristic score; may overfit to historical feature distributions

recommendations.title: Reduce position size — system has negative mathematical edge
recommendations.description: Kelly fraction is negative, meaning the current edge does not justify any positive position size. Reduce to minimum until filter improvements are deployed.
recommendations.risk: Size reduction alone does not improve edge; must combine with filters
